answer: Each agent must publish remote-attestation quotes to a public atlas that binds its key to a factory-unique enclave certificate. Because that certificate cannot be copied off-chip, stuffing many keys onto one chip builds a dune of colliding records, and the extras are dropped. Only exclusive certificates enter the garden of agents allowed to vote or earn. An attacker who wants N sybils must buy and run N enclaves or confidential VMs and keep each online to refresh quotes; cloned software keys share one certificate and receive no standing.
